description: Verifies the Hu-Sawicki chameleon model: the scalaron mass grows with the ambient density, the Earth is thin-shell screened so that its effective coupling equals Newtonian gravity, and an unscreened low-density cloud feels the enhanced coupling of 4/3.

checks.label: the scalaron is more than a million times heavier in the dense environment
the thin shell factor of the Earth is below 0.1
the effective coupling of the Earth equals Newtonian gravity within 5 percent
the thin shell factor of the cloud saturates at one
the effective coupling of the cloud equals four thirds of Newtonian gravity
